fields.statement: At 72436a158 in a detached checkout: go test -trimpath ./internal/run/ -run 'TestVerifierTier|TestVerifierRisky' -v passes all six tests, and go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... passes. The tests start verifiers from a role with models [opus], low_risk_models [sonnet], risky_paths [.github/**]. They journal sonnet for a low-risk first attempt touching only internal/x/x.go (TestVerifierTierChoice) and for review cycle 2's first fix on that file (TestVerifierTierReviewCycle). They journal opus for .github/workflows/ci.yml, an unreadable diff and a role without low_risk_models (TestVerifierTierChoice), for attempt 2 (TestVerifierTierRetry), for a fresh round (TestVerifierTierFreshRound) and for cycle 2's second fix try (TestVerifierTierReviewRetry). Cycle 3 is risky whatever the diff (TestVerifierRiskyRetryStates). The diff to verifierRisky and startLeaf matches: a checks step is a retry when the cycle is past 2, the try is not leafFixAttempt(cycle,1), or the round is past 1, and a low-risk launch takes the cheap ladder's first model. make self-check exits 0. build-workflow.txtar fails at :46 (it expects opus verifiers); that comes from the build.toml defaults and is already a confirmed review finding, not part of this leaf's acceptance.
